description: As a deployment engineer, you have received a report containing a list of services that have been updated in the last week. The plain-text file is located at /home/user/deployment_data/service_updates.log. Each line in this file contains the name of a service (e.g., webserver, auth, db), and some services may appear multiple times if they were updated more than once. Your goal is to generate a frequency report showing each unique service and the number of updates it received. Please process the file so that: 1. The output is sorted by service name (alphabetical order, A-Z). 2. Each line in the output file should be formatted as <service_name>: <frequency>. For example: webserver: 3. 3. The output file must be named /home/user/deployment_data/service_update_frequencies.log. 4. The output file must NOT contain any extra blank lines, leading/trailing spaces, or header/footer text—just the frequency count lines as described. After completing the task, verify that /home/user/deployment_data/service_update_frequencies.log exists and contains the correct frequency counts in the specified format.
